explicit_requirements: Dispatch a packed shipment with units already reserved by marking it shipped and recording its tracking reference.
Subtract the shipment quantity from both on-hand and reserved inventory units.
Reject an empty tracking reference without changing the shipment or inventory.
Reject insufficient on-hand stock without changing the shipment or inventory.
Dispatching a shipped shipment again must not deduct inventory a second time.
ambiguities: Whether a whitespace-only tracking reference counts as empty and whether tracking text should be normalized are unspecified.
When a shipped shipment is submitted again with a different tracking reference, the task does not specify whether to preserve or replace the reference.
Handling inconsistent reserved counts or nonpositive shipment quantities is not specified; the request assumes units have already been reserved.

scenarios.name: Dispatch updates shipment and both inventory counts
scenarios.behavior: For a packed shipment with sufficient on-hand and reserved units and a nonempty tracking reference, dispatch marks it shipped, records the reference, and subtracts exactly its quantity from both inventory counts.
scenarios.reason: All four related state updates are directly required by the task; the context names the shipment and inventory fields.

scenarios.name: Reject empty tracking without state changes
scenarios.behavior: Dispatch with an empty tracking string is rejected and preserves both shipment and inventory records.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly requires rejection and preservation of both records for an empty tracking reference.

scenarios.name: Reject insufficient stock without state changes
scenarios.behavior: Dispatch with on-hand stock below the shipment quantity is rejected and preserves both records.
scenarios.reason: The task directly specifies insufficient on-hand stock as a rejection condition with no changes.

scenarios.name: Repeated dispatch does not deduct inventory again
scenarios.behavior: After dispatching a shipment, dispatching that same shipped shipment again leaves both inventory counts at their post-dispatch values.
scenarios.reason: The task explicitly prohibits a second inventory deduction on repeated dispatch.
